'''''Chi'ffa''''' was a hot beverage enjoyed by [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]].

[[Bie Breil'lya]] wanted a glass of iced ''chi'ffa'' right before he was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Andov Syn]].
